beats.label: S1 · Sarah moves home
beats.text: Single mother Sarah moves back to Berkeley with teens Amber and Drew; her siblings and parents make room in their orderly adult lives.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the premise and Sarah's family unit that anchors every later storyline.

beats.label: S1 · Max's diagnosis
beats.text: Adam and Kristina learn their young son Max has Asperger's; they share it with the siblings but hide it from Max himself, and Adam quietly becomes the family's fixer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The secret from Max is a ticking bomb that detonates in S2.

beats.label: S1 · Jabbar arrives
beats.text: Crosby's ex Jasmine reappears with five-year-old Jabbar; a paternity test confirms Crosby is the father, dragging the commitment-phobe into fatherhood.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Jasmine/Jabbar dynamic that defines Crosby's entire arc.

beats.label: S1 · Zeek's affair
beats.text: Sarah discovers Zeek had an affair and secretly lost the family's money; Camille throws him out but eventually accepts his public plea to come home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fractures the parents' marriage — the foundation everyone else stands on.

beats.label: S1 · Cousins collide
beats.text: Amber sleeps with Haddie's ex-boyfriend Steve, blowing up the cousins' friendship and forcing Sarah and Kristina into a bitter argument over parenting.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements the Sarah/Kristina friction and Amber's role as the disruptive teen.

beats.label: S1 · Jasmine's contract
beats.text: Jasmine wins a New York dance contract and plans to move with Jabbar; Crosby decides he wants to move with them to be present in his son's life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: S2 opens with Crosby stranded and Jabbar in New York — the beat that sets that up.

beats.label: S1 · Amber runs, Zeek returns
beats.text: Amber runs away after being blamed for the family's rifts; Sarah, Kristina and Haddie find her together, and Zeek publicly wins Camille back with the family watching.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets both the parents' marriage and the sisters-in-law rift heading into S2.

cliffhanger.text: The Braverman family has absorbed Sarah's chaos and forgiven Zeek's affair, Crosby has decided to follow his newly discovered son to New York, and Max still doesn't know why school is so hard for him.
questions: Will Crosby actually move to New York with Jasmine and Jabbar, or lose them?
When will Adam and Kristina tell Max the truth about his diagnosis?
Can Zeek's marriage survive the affair he was just barely forgiven for?

characters.name: Sarah Braverman
characters.line: Recently divorced mother of Amber and Drew, just moved home to Berkeley to restart her life at forty.

characters.name: Adam Braverman
characters.line: Sarah's steady older brother, married to Kristina; the family's reflexive fixer with a demanding job.

characters.name: Kristina Braverman
characters.line: Adam's wife and mother to teen Haddie and young Max, learning to advocate after Max's Asperger's diagnosis.

characters.name: Max Braverman
characters.line: Adam and Kristina's young son, newly diagnosed with Asperger's — the family knows, he doesn't.

characters.name: Haddie Braverman
characters.line: Adam and Kristina's teenage daughter, freshly hurt after her cousin Amber slept with her ex-boyfriend Steve.

characters.name: Crosby Braverman
characters.line: Sarah's commitment-phobic younger brother, blindsided by fatherhood after learning about Jabbar.

characters.name: Jasmine Trussell
characters.line: Crosby's ex and Jabbar's mother, a dancer just moving to New York for a company contract.

characters.name: Julia Braverman-Graham
characters.line: The youngest sibling, a corporate lawyer married to stay-at-home Joel and mother to daughter Sydney.

characters.name: Joel Graham
characters.line: Julia's stay-at-home husband, the calm counterweight to her ambition.

characters.name: Amber Holt
characters.line: Sarah's rebellious teenage daughter, just reconciled with her mother after running away.

characters.name: Zeek Braverman
characters.line: Patriarch just publicly forgiven for an affair and for losing the family's money in bad investments.

characters.name: Camille Braverman
characters.line: Matriarch who took Zeek back after his affair; quietly rediscovering her painting on her own terms.

beats.label: S2 · Sarah at Adam's job
beats.text: Adam pitches Sarah's shoe-tracker idea to his boss Gordon and hires her at the company; Gordon later sells the company, and the new owner Cory eventually fires Adam.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Adam's unemployment that drives S3's Luncheonette purchase.

beats.label: S2 · Crosby proposes
beats.text: Crosby wins Jasmine back after she quits the European tour and returns to Berkeley, and proposes to her on Halloween night while trick-or-treating with Jabbar.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The engagement he then destroys is the whole spine of Crosby's second half.

beats.label: S2 · Haddie and Alex
beats.text: Haddie falls for Alex, an older recovering alcoholic who volunteers at a food bank; her parents forbid it and she moves out to her grandparents' in protest.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Haddie's first real independence and the wedge that puts Alex in the family circle.

beats.label: S2 · Sarah writes a play
beats.text: Sarah begins a stage play about her ex Seth with the help of Mark, who advises her on the writing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Mark Cyr, Sarah's main partner through S3, and her writing life.

beats.label: S2 · Julia can't conceive
beats.text: Julia and Joel try for a second child and learn Julia is unlikely to get pregnant due to scarring; she begins to think about adoption.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Directly seeds Julia's Zoe/adoption arc that dominates S3.

beats.label: S2 · Crosby wrecks it
beats.text: Crosby sleeps with Max's aide Gaby the night of Max's birthday; the confrontation blows up his engagement, and Max overhears the fight and learns he has Asperger's.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fires two long-buried storylines at once: Crosby's betrayal of Jasmine and Max's diagnosis reveal.

beats.label: S2 · Crash and pregnancy
beats.text: Amber, rejected from every college, gets high and is T-boned in a coworker's car; at the hospital Adam is finally fired and Kristina reveals she is pregnant with their third child.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The triple hit — Amber's near-death, Adam's unemployment, Kristina's pregnancy — that launches S3.

cliffhanger.text: Adam is out of a job with a fourth mouth on the way, Crosby has blown up his engagement to Jasmine, and Amber has just survived a crash caused by her own spiral — while Max, for the first time, knows what's wrong with him.
questions: What will Adam do for money now with a third child coming?
Can Crosby ever earn back Jasmine's trust after cheating with Gaby?
Will Amber straighten out, or is she starting to become her father?

characters.name: Sarah Braverman
characters.line: Writer with a produced play about her ex, after a burned affair with Adam's boss.

characters.name: Adam Braverman
characters.line: Freshly fired from the company he brought Sarah into, expecting a third child with Kristina.

characters.name: Kristina Braverman
characters.line: Pregnant after months of overwork and parenting Max through his Asperger's revelation.

characters.name: Max Braverman
characters.line: Now knows he has Asperger's after overhearing Adam and Crosby's fight; still working out what it means.

characters.name: Haddie Braverman
characters.line: Reached a mutual agreement with Adam and Kristina over when she can see Alex.

characters.name: Crosby Braverman
characters.line: Single again after cheating on Jasmine with Max's aide Gaby, estranged from the woman he was about to marry.

characters.name: Jasmine Trussell
characters.line: Broke off her engagement to Crosby after his affair; raising Jabbar alone back in Berkeley.

characters.name: Julia Braverman-Graham
characters.line: Just learned she cannot easily conceive a second child; starting to consider adoption with Joel.

characters.name: Joel Graham
characters.line: Julia's husband, quietly supporting her through the fertility grief.

characters.name: Amber Holt
characters.line: Just survived a serious car crash after spiraling from college rejections and drug use.

characters.name: Zeek Braverman
characters.line: His marriage is stable but tested when he grows jealous of Camille's art teacher.

characters.name: Camille Braverman
characters.line: Painting seriously again and rebuilding her marriage on her own terms.

characters.name: Mark Cyr
characters.line: Mark — advises Sarah on her writing when she begins a story about Seth.

beats.label: S3 · The Luncheonette
beats.text: Adam and Crosby pool their money to buy the Luncheonette recording studio, staking Adam's family finances on Crosby's flakier ambitions.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The business that defines both brothers for the rest of the series begins here.

beats.label: S3 · Nora arrives
beats.text: Kristina goes into labor while Adam is chasing a first big client; Crosby helps deliver Nora, and Kristina throws herself back into supermom mode.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nora's birth and Adam's absence during it colors the rest of the season.

beats.label: S3 · Sarah and Mark, again
beats.text: Sarah refuses Mark's push for a baby and briefly reconnects with sober ex Seth; Mark returns at the season's finale to propose to her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Where Sarah's relationships stand — and Mark's still-open proposal — heading into S4.

beats.label: S3 · Zoe changes her mind
beats.text: Julia latches onto Zoe, a pregnant coworker, and secures her promise to adopt the baby; Zoe reneges at the hospital and keeps her son.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The failed adoption that leaves Julia and Joel primed to accept Victor.

beats.label: S3 · Rachel's kiss
beats.text: The Luncheonette's new receptionist Rachel kisses Adam; he confesses to Kristina, while a lonely Crosby's own drunken slip with Jasmine rekindles their romance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets both marriages — Adam's honesty stabilizes his, Crosby's slip restarts his engagement path.

beats.label: S3 · Amber and Bob Little
beats.text: Amber's job on candidate Bob Little's mayoral campaign turns into a real relationship Kristina personally shuts down in his hotel room.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Bob Little, whom Kristina will run against in S5.

beats.label: S3 · Wedding and Victor
beats.text: Crosby and Jasmine finally marry in the Bravermans' backyard; the same evening, a case worker introduces Julia and Joel to a preteen foster boy named Victor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two long-set-up families gain their new members — the twin engines of S4.

cliffhanger.text: Crosby and Jasmine are married, Adam and Crosby own a functioning studio, and Sarah has a fresh proposal from Mark — while Julia and Joel have just invited a preteen boy neither of them knows into their living room.
questions: Can Julia and Joel actually parent Victor, a ten-year-old who never chose them?
Will Sarah accept Mark's second proposal after refusing to have his baby?
Can the Luncheonette pay Adam's bills with two young kids and a newborn at home?

characters.name: Sarah Braverman
characters.line: Just received a marriage proposal from Mark at Crosby's wedding; hasn't answered yet.

characters.name: Adam Braverman
characters.line: Co-owner of the Luncheonette recording studio and new father to baby Nora.

characters.name: Kristina Braverman
characters.line: Mother of Nora, back in full supermom mode with three kids.

characters.name: Max Braverman
characters.line: Attending mainstream public school and slowly making friends despite social bumps.

characters.name: Crosby Braverman
characters.line: Newlywed to Jasmine and Luncheonette co-owner — the family man he never was in his twenties.

characters.name: Jasmine Trussell
characters.line: Now Jasmine Braverman; married to Crosby after forgiving his infidelity, running their household with Jabbar.

characters.name: Julia Braverman-Graham
characters.line: About to parent a preteen foster boy after a failed private adoption devastated her.

characters.name: Joel Graham
characters.line: Julia's steady husband, immediately ready to take Victor in as their son.

characters.name: Amber Holt
characters.line: Back on her feet after the crash, working on the Bob Little campaign until Kristina ended her affair with him.

characters.name: Zeek Braverman
characters.line: The family's patriarch, still solidly with Camille, taking on younger vets as new causes.

characters.name: Camille Braverman
characters.line: Painting, running the family home, and pushing Zeek to grow up alongside her.

characters.name: Mark Cyr
characters.line: Sarah's English-teacher partner, who just proposed to her at Crosby's wedding.

characters.name: Victor Graham
characters.line: The ten-year-old foster child whose mother is incarcerated, just met Julia and Joel at their door.

beats.label: S4 · Kristina's diagnosis
beats.text: During a routine mammogram Kristina is diagnosed with breast cancer, days after driving Haddie to Cornell for her freshman year.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central storyline and the reason every other plotline reshapes.

beats.label: S4 · Julia quits, Victor struggles
beats.text: Overwhelmed at her law firm, Julia has a breakdown and quits, becoming stay-at-home mother to Victor, who is failing to fit in at school or at home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Julia losing her career identity while parenting Victor drives everything for her in S5.

beats.label: S4 · Hank enters
beats.text: Sarah takes a photography assistant job with the gruff Hank Rizzoli; despite still being engaged to Mark, she starts becoming central to Hank's life and his daughter Ruby's.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Hank, who becomes Sarah's long-term partner from here forward.

beats.label: S4 · Amber and Ryan
beats.text: Amber falls for Ryan, a young Afghanistan veteran Zeek befriends at the VA; his PTSD strains them, but by year's end they reconcile.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Ryan, whose instability becomes Amber's whole S5.

beats.label: S4 · The septic shock
beats.text: Kristina goes into septic shock and records a farewell video for the family before pulling through; months later she rings the chemo bell cancer-free.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The near-death and the recovery both drive Kristina's restless energy in S5.

beats.label: S4 · Sarah picks Hank
beats.text: Mark ends the engagement and Sarah picks Hank — just as Hank moves to Minnesota to be near his daughter Ruby.
beats.whyLoadBearing: S5 opens with Sarah in a long-distance relationship this beat creates.

beats.label: S4 · Victor and Aida
beats.text: Julia and Joel officially adopt Victor at a family ceremony; the same finale, Jasmine reveals to Crosby that she is pregnant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two more kids formally join the Bravermans, reshaping both households for S5.

cliffhanger.text: Kristina has beaten cancer, Victor is legally Julia and Joel's son, and Sarah has chosen Hank — who has just moved states to be near his daughter. Amber and Ryan are back together, but he is still fighting a war in his head.
questions: Can Sarah and Hank actually make it work across state lines?
Is Ryan stable enough for Amber to build a life with?
Now that Victor is theirs, can Julia find any meaning outside her old career?

characters.name: Sarah Braverman
characters.line: In a fresh long-distance relationship with Hank after Mark ended their engagement.

characters.name: Hank Rizzoli
characters.line: Sarah's gruff photographer partner, just moved to Minnesota to be close to his daughter Ruby.

characters.name: Adam Braverman
characters.line: Kristina's caregiver through cancer, still co-running the Luncheonette with Crosby.

characters.name: Kristina Braverman
characters.line: Newly cancer-free after a scare that put her in septic shock; restless with what to do next.

characters.name: Max Braverman
characters.line: Still at his mainstream public school, more opinionated and independent as he grows up.

characters.name: Crosby Braverman
characters.line: Married to Jasmine and about to become a father for the second time.

characters.name: Jasmine Braverman
characters.line: Just told Crosby she is pregnant with their daughter.

characters.name: Julia Braverman-Graham
characters.line: Stay-at-home mother to Victor and Sydney after quitting her law firm in a breakdown.

characters.name: Joel Graham
characters.line: Working a full-time construction job; distance quietly growing between him and Julia.

characters.name: Victor Graham
characters.line: Julia and Joel's newly adopted son, still cautious about trusting a family that chose him.

characters.name: Amber Holt
characters.line: Reconciled with Ryan after a rocky year, both trying to make his PTSD survivable.

characters.name: Ryan York
characters.line: Young Afghanistan veteran with PTSD, Amber's partner; back in therapy at year's end.

characters.name: Zeek Braverman
characters.line: Patriarch increasingly aware of his own limits, mentoring vets like Ryan at the VA.

characters.name: Camille Braverman
characters.line: A steady maternal presence in the family, stepping in to support Kristina through her illness.

beats.label: S5 · Ryan proposes
beats.text: Ryan comes home on leave from Kandahar and impulsively proposes to Amber; the family swallows its doubts and helps her plan the wedding.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The engagement is the frame the whole Amber/Ryan collapse hangs on.

beats.label: S5 · Kristina runs for mayor
beats.text: Restless post-cancer, Kristina runs for mayor against Bob Little; she loses on election night but resolves instead to open a school for kids like Max.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Chambers Academy plan she starts here becomes S6's central project.

beats.label: S5 · Julia and Joel split
beats.text: Joel throws himself into work with architect Peet as Julia unravels at home; Ed kisses her, and Joel moves out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The separation that dominates the back half of the show.

beats.label: S5 · Ryan unravels
beats.text: Ryan is arrested for a drunken bar fight and re-enlists in the Army; a shattered Amber goes to visit her sober father Seth for the first time in years.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ryan's re-enlistment and Amber's turn to Seth reshape her entire trajectory.

beats.label: S5 · The house is sold
beats.text: Camille joins an Italian art class alone and Zeek finally agrees to sell the Braverman family home to fulfill her long-deferred wishes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Losing the physical center of every previous season sets the tone for S6.

beats.label: S5 · Hank confronts himself
beats.text: Suspecting he may be on the spectrum himself, Hank consults Max's specialist and uses what he learns to reconcile with Sarah for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Sarah and Hank as a durable couple for S6's finale wedding.

beats.label: S5 · The crash and the test
beats.text: Ryan is nearly killed in a car crash near his new base; Amber drives to San Diego with Hank, and afterwards is seen buying a pregnancy test.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The hospital, the pregnancy, and Ryan's absence together power the S6 premiere.

cliffhanger.text: Ryan is broken in a hospital bed halfway across the country, Amber is holding a pregnancy test, Julia and Joel are separated and both have strayed, and the family home has been sold — the center of everything has come apart.
questions: Will Ryan survive his crash, and can Amber raise a baby alone if he does?
Can Julia and Joel find their way back after both have strayed?
Where does this family gather now that the house they grew up in is gone?

characters.name: Sarah Braverman
characters.line: Fully committed to Hank after his own reckoning with himself brought them back together.

characters.name: Hank Rizzoli
characters.line: Sarah's partner, back in Berkeley for good and learning to name his own struggles with intimacy.

characters.name: Adam Braverman
characters.line: Expanding the Luncheonette into a record label and preparing to help Kristina build a school for kids like Max.

characters.name: Kristina Braverman
characters.line: Lost the mayoral race but pivoted to launching Chambers Academy; fully cancer-free.

characters.name: Max Braverman
characters.line: Attending public middle school, still socially struggling and about to move to Chambers.

characters.name: Crosby Braverman
characters.line: Father of two now, juggling the baby and Jabbar while running the Luncheonette's new label.

characters.name: Jasmine Braverman
characters.line: Mother to Jabbar and newborn Aida, adjusting to life with a new baby.

characters.name: Julia Braverman-Graham
characters.line: Separated from Joel; briefly slept with Max's teacher Evan Knight before cutting it off, still in love with Joel.

characters.name: Joel Graham
characters.line: Living apart from Julia, working closely with architect Peet, refusing to attend marriage counseling.

characters.name: Amber Holt
characters.line: Engagement collapsed after Ryan re-enlisted; visited him in the hospital after his crash and left holding a pregnancy test.

characters.name: Ryan York
characters.line: Recovering from a car crash near his base; unstable, absent, and headed to live with his mother in Wyoming.

characters.name: Victor Graham
characters.line: Held back a grade this year and adjusting to Julia and Joel's split.

characters.name: Zeek Braverman
characters.line: Has just sold the family home to give Camille the life she's asked for; slower physically but at peace.

characters.name: Camille Braverman
characters.line: Preparing to move into a small Victorian with Zeek after finally winning the argument about their future.

beats.label: S6 · Zeek in Vegas
beats.text: Zeek collapses in a Vegas casino during a birthday trip and is diagnosed with heart failure; he refuses risky surgery until Amber's pregnancy news changes his mind.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the season's whole thread — Zeek's mortality and whether he'll survive to meet his great-grandchild.

beats.label: S6 · Amber chooses alone
beats.text: Amber visits Ryan in Wyoming, sees his ongoing substance abuse, and quietly decides she will raise their son without him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Amber's path as a single mother, the emotional counterweight to Zeek's decline.

beats.label: S6 · Julia and Joel repair
beats.text: Joel apologizes for giving up on their marriage and asks Julia back; the two rebuild slowly while Sydney and Victor struggle between two homes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restoring the family's other pillar marriage before Zeek's death makes the finale bearable.

beats.label: S6 · Chambers Academy opens
beats.text: Kristina opens Chambers Academy as headmistress; her hardest case is Max, whose first crush on classmate Dylan ends in a public humiliation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The school and Max's coming of age are the season's optimistic through-line.

beats.label: S6 · Second heart attack
beats.text: Zeek has a second heart attack and this time refuses further surgery, choosing to spend his remaining time with Camille; Amber gives birth to a boy she names Zeek.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Zeek's decision and his namesake grandson set up the finale's dual arc.

beats.label: S6 · A wedding, a funeral
beats.text: Sarah moves her wedding up so a weakened Zeek can walk her down the aisle to Hank; days later Zeek dies peacefully in his sleep beside Camille.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's emotional summit — Sarah settled, and Zeek's arc closed.

beats.label: S6 · Ashes on the field
beats.text: The Bravermans scatter Zeek's ashes on a baseball field and, exactly as he asked, play a game together in his memory as the family walks off the diamond.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The series' closing image and the family's collective goodbye.

cliffhanger.text: Zeek is gone, but the family he built is intact and moving on — Julia and Joel back together, Amber holding a son named for her grandfather, Sarah married, Chambers Academy growing, and Camille preparing to travel the world Zeek never got to see.
questions: Can the Bravermans hold together without Zeek at the center?
What will Camille do with the years and freedom she still has?
Will the boy Amber named for his grandfather carry any of what Zeek was?

characters.name: Sarah Braverman
characters.line: Now Hank's wife after a wedding Zeek walked her down the aisle for.

characters.name: Hank Rizzoli
characters.line: Sarah's husband and a steady father to his daughter Ruby.

characters.name: Adam Braverman
characters.line: Newly headmaster of a growing Chambers Academy network after Kristina stepped back.

characters.name: Kristina Braverman
characters.line: Founded Chambers Academy and is now handing the day-to-day to Adam as it scales.

characters.name: Max Braverman
characters.line: Graduated from Chambers Academy, more socially assured than the boy who couldn't stand a school hallway.

characters.name: Crosby Braverman
characters.line: Reopened the Luncheonette with Amber as his new partner after Adam stepped away for the school.

characters.name: Jasmine Braverman
characters.line: Crosby's wife and mother of their children; anchored the family through the Luncheonette's near-shutdown.

characters.name: Julia Braverman-Graham
characters.line: Fully reconciled with Joel and about to adopt another child from Victor's biological mother.

characters.name: Joel Graham
characters.line: Back home with Julia and the kids after their long separation.

characters.name: Amber Holt
characters.line: Mother to baby Zeek and Crosby's new business partner at the Luncheonette.

characters.name: Ryan York
characters.line: Alive after his crash and living with his mother in Wyoming; visits his son from a distance.

characters.name: Victor Graham
characters.line: Settling into a stable home now that Julia and Joel are back together.

characters.name: Zeek Braverman
characters.line: Died peacefully in his sleep after choosing his time with Camille over another surgery; his ashes scattered on a baseball field.

characters.name: Camille Braverman
characters.line: A widow honoring Zeek's plans for them by finally taking the trip to France he'd promised her.
